posts.cooked:
As I listen back through all the Letters Pages from the beginning (a process I’ve barely begun), I’m often tempted to make some kind of comment here, of some marginally clever thing I was touched off to think, but in most cases I’m holding fire. But in this case, I just can’t keep it to myself.

Since the whole world is in love with the characters published by Sentinel Comics, there have been many adaptations in every possible medium, including video games. One of the latest and greatest of these is “Inequality 2”, the sequel to the groundbreaking original video game “Inequality”, published by Not There Realm Studios.

There, now that I got that off my chest, I’ll get back to listening.
